step1_analysis.description: A classic two-stage uncompensated operational amplifier with a PMOS input differential pair and an NMOS common-source second stage. It is designed to drive large capacitive loads, which is typical for interfacing with macroscopic biological sensors like tripolar cuff electrodes.

paper_reference.title: An Adaptive ENG Amplifier for Tripolar Cuff Electrodes

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming 10uA bias: gm1 = sqrt(2*50u*10*5u) = 70.7uS. Rout1 = ro2||ro4 = 1MOhm. Stage 1 Gain = 70.7 V/V (37 dB). gm9 = sqrt(2*270u*10*10u) = 232uS. Rout2 = ro7||ro9 = 500kOhm. Stage 2 Gain = 116 V/V (41 dB). Total Gain = 37 + 41 = 78 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using standard square-law models for SKY130 1.8V devices. The paper's 54 dB may refer to the closed-loop system gain or a heavily loaded state.

UGF.description: Unity gain frequency where open-loop gain drops to 0 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: With a 1nF load (typical for cuff electrodes): Dominant pole p1 = 1/(2*pi*Rout2*CL) = 1/(2*pi*500k*1nF) = 318 Hz. UGF = DC_Gain * p1 = 8200 * 318 = 2.6 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Assumes a 1nF load capacitance to ensure stability, as the OTA lacks an internal Miller compensation capacitor.

Phase_Margin.description: Stability margin at unity gain frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Second pole p2 at first stage output = 1/(2*pi*1MOhm*21fF) = 7.5 MHz. Phase shift at UGF (2.6 MHz) = atan(2.6/7.5) = 19 degrees. PM = 90 - 19 = 71 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Stable with a 1nF load. Without a large external load, the uncompensated OTA would be unstable.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current = Ibias + Itail + Iout = 10uA + 10uA + 10uA = 30uA. Power = 30uA * 1.8V = 54 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on a 10uA reference current mirrored to the tail and output stages.

Slew_Rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the 10uA output stage bias current charging the large 1nF load.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring DC Gain, UGF, Phase Margin, Power, and Slew Rate of the Two-Stage OTA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Adaptive ENG Amplifier (Two-Stage OTA)
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N_M1_D I_I N_TAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N_M2_D N_M2_G N_TAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N_M1_D N_M1_D VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N_M2_D N_M1_D VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N_BIAS N_BIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N_TAIL N_BIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 V_O N_BIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N_M2_D VDD N_M8_S VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 V_O N_M2_D VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

* Dummy resistor to prevent floating node matrix singularity
Rdummy N_M8_S 0 1T

* Supplies and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
Ibias N_BIAS 0 10u

* Input Signal (DC for OP/AC, Pulse for Tran)
Vcm N_M2_G 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 pulse(0.4 0.9 10u 1u 1u 100u 200u)

* Feedback network (Closed loop at DC, Open loop at AC)
L1 V_O I_I 1G
C1 I_I 0 1G

* Load capacitance (Large to stabilize uncompensated OTA)
CL V_O 0 1n

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 1 100Meg
  let gain_db = vdb(V_O)
  let phase_deg = 180/PI * cph(v(V_O))
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_ugf find phase_deg when gain_db=0 fall=1
  let pm = 180 + phase_at_ugf
  print pm

  * 3. Transient Analysis (Step Response)
  * Alter feedback to unity-gain buffer for transient
  alter L1 1p
  alter C1 1a
  tran 1u 200u
  
  meas tran trise trig v(V_O) val=0.5 rise=1 targ v(V_O) val=0.8 rise=1
  meas tran tfall trig v(V_O) val=0.8 fall=1 targ v(V_O) val=0.5 fall=1
  
  let sr_rise_vus = (0.3 / trise) * 1e-6
  let sr_fall_vus = (0.3 / tfall) * 1e-6
  print sr_rise_vus sr_fall_vus
  
  quit
.endc
.end
